content.comment_body: Hello, I created a program using the demo version of [product_name] (I own [product_name] [version_no]), but I missed that I was working in the demo environment instead of the licensed one. How can I convert the file created in the demo to a functional file? When I try to open it in [product_name] [version_no], I receive an error message saying the software can't open it (since it was made in the demo). Do I need to rewrite my program entirely? Thank you for your help, [user_name]

I've attempted to reproduce your issue, and it worked for me. The software I used: Program written in [product_name] [version_no] Demo, then opened in [product_name] [version_no] (full version). Could you upload a screenshot showing your problem?

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter confusion and workflow disruptions when files created using the demo edition of [product_name] fail to open in the licensed version. Uncertainty about compatibility between demo and full versions leads to concerns about losing work or having to recreate projects.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate seamless file compatibility and migration between demo and full versions of [product_name], without needing to re-do work.
